title: Derivative of the biased expectation polynomial
statement: For every real-valued function $f$ on $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ and every real number $\\mu$, the biased expectation polynomial $P_f(\\mu)=\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n]}\\mu^{|S|}\\widehat f(S)$ is differentiable at $\\mu$ with derivative $\\sum_{S\\subseteq[n]}|S|\\mu^{|S|-1}\\widehat f(S)$.
